chunks.title: Property tax 2026–27
chunks.text: Property tax for 2026–27 is due by 31 July 2026. Owners who pay the full year's tax by 30 April 2026 receive a 5% rebate.

chunks.title: Property tax 2026–27
chunks.text: Tax not paid by 31 July attracts a penalty of 2% of the unpaid amount for each month of delay.

chunks.title: Property tax 2026–27
chunks.text: You can pay online on the KMC citizen portal with UPI, net banking or a card, or in person at any ward office. Keep the receipt: it is needed for many other KMC services.

chunks.title: Birth and death certificates
chunks.text: Births and deaths in Kalpanagar must be registered with the KMC within 21 days. Hospitals register births that happen in them; for a birth at home, a parent registers it at the ward office.

chunks.title: Birth and death certificates
chunks.text: Certificates can be downloaded from the KMC citizen portal once registration is complete. Printed copies cost ₹20 each and are ready in 7 working days.

chunks.title: New water connection
chunks.text: To apply for a new water connection, bring the latest property tax receipt, proof of ownership or a rent agreement with the owner's consent, and an identity proof such as Aadhaar or a voter ID.

chunks.title: New water connection
chunks.text: The connection fee is ₹500, plus a refundable deposit of ₹3,000. A meter is fitted with every new connection.

chunks.title: New water connection
chunks.text: The KMC completes new connections within 15 working days of a complete application.

chunks.title: Garbage collection
chunks.text: Wet waste is collected every day between 7 and 10 am. Dry waste is collected on Wednesdays and Saturdays.

chunks.title: Garbage collection
chunks.text: Households must keep wet and dry waste separate. Handing over mixed waste can lead to a fine of ₹200.

chunks.title: Garbage collection
chunks.text: Garden waste and old furniture are collected on request: book a bulk pickup on the KMC citizen portal.

chunks.title: Trade licence
chunks.text: Every shop, restaurant or workshop in Kalpanagar needs a trade licence from the KMC.

chunks.title: Trade licence
chunks.text: Licences must be renewed every year by 31 March. Late renewal costs ₹100 for each month of delay.

chunks.title: Complaints and grievances
chunks.text: Complaints about roads, streetlights, water or garbage can be filed on the KMC citizen portal or at a ward office. Every complaint gets a tracking number.

chunks.title: Complaints and grievances
chunks.text: The KMC aims to respond to a complaint within 3 working days. If it is not resolved in 15 working days, it is escalated to the zonal commissioner.
